timeline.title: A Short History of Fun
items: Friedrich Froebel opened a school where little ones learned through play. It became the first kindergarten.
The first teddy bears were made, named after a president called Teddy who refused to shoot a captured bear.
The LEGO brick we know today was patented, and children have been building towers ever since.
Sesame Street first came on television, teaching letters, numbers and kindness with puppets.
today: Age {age}, expert in {expert}, and the best thing that ever happened to us.

letters.title: Clever Things People Have Said
items: There is no one alive who is Youer than You.
Dr. Seuss, Happy Birthday to You!, 1959
Those who don't believe in magic will never find it.
Imagination is more important than knowledge.
All children, except one, grow up.
letters.hand: Grow as slowly as you like, {who}. We are enjoying every minute.

facts.title: Fun Facts to Amaze Your Friends
items: You were born with about 300 bones. Some join together as you grow, so grown ups have 206.
Your heart is about the same size as your fist, and it grows bigger as you do.
Your brain grows super fast when you are little. By age six it is nearly grown up sized.
An octopus has three hearts and blue blood. Imagine how many hugs it could give!
There is no wind on the Moon, so the astronauts' footprints could stay there for a very long time.
Honey found in ancient Egyptian tombs, thousands of years old, was still good to eat.
facts.hand: Science is amazing. But the most amazing thing of all is you, {who}.

world.close: The world is brighter, sillier and happier because of you, {who}.

To love you more than all the stars.

note.title: What we believe a child is
paras: We make magazines for a living, but some feel different. This was one of them.
We believe a child is a whole universe of wonder: big questions, muddy knees, brave hearts and the funniest ideas anyone has ever had.
{who}, the people who love you wanted you to have something special. A magazine all about you, because you are the star of the show.
One day, when you are all grown up, you can read this again and remember how loved you were, right from the very start.
note.wish: Keep shining, {who}. The world needs you.
